# Lateral Movements

> > A personal travel blog chronicling Lauren's working holidays and expat experiences across Ireland, England, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea, and Belgium.

Lateral Movements documents unconventional career paths and cross-cultural adventures, focusing on working holidays, teaching abroad, road trips, and navigating life as an expat. The blog offers firsthand perspectives on alternative lifestyles and international living.
